jobs.occupation: Project Manager - International Industrial Technology Group
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international industrial technology group providing engineered solutions that improve workplace safety, environmental performance and production efficiency. As Project Manager, you will oversee industrial installation projects from order confirmation through commissioning, coordinating customers, subcontractors and internal teams to ensure successful delivery.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage industrial projects from order confirmation to final handover
• Act as the main point of contact for customers throughout execution
• Review purchase orders and contractual requirements
• Coordinate subcontractors, installers and internal stakeholders
• Plan resources, schedules and site activities
• Monitor budgets, milestones, risks and project profitability
• Negotiate scope changes and contractual deviations
• Ensure accurate reporting, documentation and customer acceptance

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering or similar
• Minimum 7 years of project management experience in a technical or industrial environment
• Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously
• Strong understanding of industrial installations, equipment or infrastructure projects
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
• Comfortable handling contractual, financial and administrative follow-up
• Ability to read technical drawings and interact with engineering teams
• CAD knowledge is a strong asset
• Fluent French and Dutch with good English
• Solution-oriented, autonomous and assertive personality

As a truck driver you are responsible to deliver and collect goods to our customers. You make collections and deliveries in all parts of Benelux or European countries. You report to the dispatching team.

 

 

You have C or CE and ADR driving license (with valid code 95).

You have a least 2 years of experience in driving with semi-trailers and are familiar with highways within BENELUX and west EU countries.

You speak Dutch (Flemish), French or English fluently. Any other European language is a plus.

You have your own car.

Do you have experience as a forklift driver?As the driver of the forklift truck with long forks, you are responsible for storing goods and loading/unloading the trucks. In addition, you sometimes help with other tasks in the warehouse (order picking, receiving, stock counting, etc.). For this, you will use a scanner.You will start in the Katoen Natie warehouses in Ghent.

Profile

• You have experience with a forklift truck with long forks (2m40) or you have extensive experience with a forklift truck with short forks and you see yourself driving the long-fork truck as well.
• A forklift certificate is not a requirement, experience is more important. There will be a theoretical and practical test
• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, you speak and understand Dutch or English well.
• You can work in a two-shift system
• You are motivated and reliable, and you prize safety and quality.
• You are flexible when it comes to hours and tasks
• In addition, you know how to use a scanner and a computer

A hands-on Network Architect role where Juniper and Fortinet meet complex, business-critical infrastructure.

Our partner is aninternational technology organisationoperating critical digital infrastructure. As part of the continued development of their infrastructure environment, they are looking for aNetwork Architectto join a highly skilled and collaborative technical team.

 

This is not a purely conceptual architecture role. You will move betweenarchitecture, design, implementation and production support, working with modern networking technologies and having a direct impact on the resilience and evolution of the infrastructure.

 

Your playground? Juniper, Fortinet, BGP, DNS, security and distributed infrastructure.
Network Architect - The Role
• Design and evolvenetwork architecturesacross complex and distributed production environments, from high-level concepts to low-level technical designs.
• Work hands-on withJuniper networking and Fortinet security technologies, including routing, switching, firewalls and network segmentation.
• Contribute toBGP, DNS/DNSSEC, high-availability and distributed infrastructure, with a strong focus on resilience and security.
• Drive improvements aroundautomation, monitoring and observability, using technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Prometheus or Grafana.
• Collaborate withInfrastructure, Security, Architecture and Software Engineeringteams, while challenging and validating technical solutions delivered by external partners.
• Maintainarchitecture documentation, diagrams and technical standards, while supporting troubleshooting, lifecycle management and production environments.
Network Architect - The Profile
• 7+ years of experiencein network, infrastructure or systems engineering, with strong exposure to critical production environments.
• Strong expertise innetworking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching and protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
• Solid hands-on experience withJuniper and Fortinet— this is a key part of the role.
• Good understanding ofLinux, DNS/DNSSEC, firewalls and high-availability/distributed infrastructure.
• Exposure tovirtualisation, containers, private cloud or Infrastructure as Code(VMware, Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, Terraform, etc.) is a strong plus.
• Analytical, pragmatic and hands-on mindset, with the ability to move from architecture and design to implementation and production troubleshooting. Fluent English is required.

Requirements

• 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with a solid backend foundation.
• You have experience designing, building, and operating software in production using Docker and Kubernetes.
• You possess a good understanding of modern SaaS concepts such as API design, distributed systems, authentication, and multi-tenancy.
• You bring experience with data technologies such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Elasticsearch.
• You have worked with modern delivery practices including CI/CD and automated deployments.
• You're comfortable investigating root causes and reasoning about architectural trade-offs.
• You possess a product mindset, focusing on solving core problems rather than just implementing features.
• You are fluent in Dutch with a good command of English.
Nice to Haves

• Hands-on experience with Golang as a primary backend language.
• Experience with Vue.js for frontend interface development.
• Knowledge of large-scale data processing using Kafka or Parquet.
• Experience with object storage platforms such as Ceph S3.
• Interest in using AI to strengthen engineering practices.
